title: Change a page with the DOM
hints: renderList: container.replaceChildren(ul) after building a ul with one li per item. Set li.textContent, never innerHTML.
setupCounter: keep let count = 0 in the function, and in the click listener do count += 1 and output.textContent = String(count).
setupFilter: on the input event, loop over the list's children and set item.hidden when the text does not include the typed value (compare in lower case).
